readerAnswers.news: Reuters reported on September 10 that the U.S. Justice Department is investigating whether Nvidia structured its December agreement with AI chip startup Groq to avoid antitrust scrutiny.
readerAnswers.mechanism: Non-exclusive means Nvidia can use the technology; it does not by itself stop Groq from using it or licensing it to others.
readerAnswers.limit: An inquiry asks for answers; it is not a finding of wrongdoing.

terms.inference: Inference is the part that uses a trained AI model to produce an answer.
terms.inquiry: An inquiry asks for answers; it is not a finding of wrongdoing.
terms.non-exclusive licence: Non-exclusive means Nvidia can use the technology; it does not by itself stop Groq from using it or licensing it to others.

explainBack: Nvidia got permission to use Groq technology and hired senior people while Groq remained independent. The Justice Department is reportedly asking what the structure changed; no finding has been reported.
unseenTransfer: For another non-exclusive licence, say the licensee may use the licensed technology and do not infer that the original company lost its use, ownership or ability to license others.
repairs: Preserved exact source passages and real editorial source resolution.

limitations: Producer review is not independent admission.
No observed human-comprehension evidence is claimed.
